mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) over the prediction horizon signals expanding economic activity, which compresses discount rates on equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained upward trend in GDPC1, or GDPC1 growth rate does not exceed a 2% annualized threshold over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on equity valuations and reducing future cash flow present value, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the rate does not sustain above 4.0% for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward momentum in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) growth and labor demand (PAYEMS) exceeding 5% and 2% respectively triggers a positive feedback loop, amplifying corporate investment and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 5% and PAYEMS growth > 2% in the prior month
regime_hint: expanding labor market and robust demand
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and PAYEMS meet the trigger thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the monthly supply index (INDPRO) over the prediction horizon reflects increased production capacity and inventory accumulation, which lowers discount rates on equity valuations and enhances future cash flow expectations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained upward trend in INDPRO, or growth rate does not exceed a 3% annualized threshold over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, which depresses equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the rate does not sustain above 6.5% for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL (inflation) above 1% and 0.5% respectively signals aggressive monetary tightening and inflationary risks, tightening financial conditions and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >1% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL meet the trigger thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) growth by >3% and housing demand (HOUST) by >10% signals robust economic activity and consumer confidence, driving corporate investment and equity valuations higher, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 3% and HOUST growth > 10% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST meet the trigger thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by low federal funds rates and suppressed inflation (CPIAUCSL), reduced discount rates on equity valuations and increased future cash flow expectations drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during the late-cycle expansion regime, or the combination of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not align with the regime's defining characteristics (e.g., FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%).
